summary: Video overlay removal aims to recover scenes obscured by subtitles, titles, and logos while preserving surrounding content. Existing methods use temporal propagation or source-conditioned generation, but can leave residual overlays and distort scene structure when useful source information is obscured.
takeaways: Experiments on the complete release show that DeOverlay outperforms four baselines on all five reconstruction and perceptual metrics, reducing Mask LPIPS and Mask VFID by 58.3% and 70.3%, respectively, relative to the strongest evaluated baseline.
We will make the complete benchmark, evaluation code, and test outputs availabl.
We propose DeOverlay, a source-anchored flow model that reconstructs the clean video from the source latent with fixed source guidance.
